summary.headline: Judging the King’s Journey
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging a king’s journey: planetary reception, retrogradation, aspects, significators, malefics, and the lord of the journey house indicate battle, pacification, safety, distress, death, gathering wealth, or tranquility and staying home.
